title: Welcome
desc: The first screen people see. Newcomers learn what the product is for and choose to sign up or sign in; people who come back find their latest work and carry on.

scenarios.title: First visit
scenarios.desc: Someone opens the product for the first time: a short welcome, then a choice between creating an account and signing in.

scenarios.title: Coming back
scenarios.desc: Sam has used the product before: the screen greets Sam by first name and lists the three things Sam worked on last, newest first, each with when it was last changed.
